exposure: Bladder injuries with concomitant ureteral injuries
cohort: 127 patients with nonendoscopic iatrogenic bladder injuries
finding: Hysterectomy and cesarean sections were the two most common causes of iatrogenic nonendoscopic bladder injuries, and a delay in diagnosis was more likely to occur during laparoscopic surgery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was one of the two most common procedures causing iatrogenic nonendoscopic bladder injuries.
